newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: SOCCER-MIJATOVIC MAINTAINS YUGOSLAVIA'S PERFECT RECORD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MIJATOVIC MAINTAINS YUGOSLAVIA'S PERFECT RECORD.

text.p: Real Madrid striker Predrag Mijatovic fired an 18th minute goal to sustain Yugoslavia's perfect record in their World Cup qualifiers with a 1-0 win against the Czech Republic 1-0 on Sunday.
Yugoslavia head European group six with 12 points from four wins in four matches and an 18-2 goals record, having previously beaten the Faroe Islands twice and Malta.
The Czech Republic are third, eight points behind the leaders but with a game in hand.
Yugoslavia's early offensive was rewarded when Mijatovic slotted the ball past goalkeeper Pavel Srnicek after receiving a pass from Dragan Stojkovic and storming down the right.
The Czechs took the initiative towards the end of the first half but Pavel Kuka, with only goalkeeper Aleksandar Kocic to beat, twice squandered chances.
Cheered by a sell-out crowd of 50,000, the Yugoslavs kept up a relentless drive in the second half but failed to make the most of a series of chances between the 45th and 70th minutes.
Both keepers were kept busy, Kocic barely clearing a left-foot thunderbolt from Smicer five minutes into injury time and seconds before the match ended.
Smicer, Jugovic, Jokanovic and Djorovic received yellow cards, as did Mijatovic, who will miss the match with Spain in Valencia on December 14 after collecting his second caution.

Yugoslavia: 1-Aleksandar Kocic, 2-Risto Vidakovic (Bratislav Zivkovic, 45th), 3-Goran Djorovic, 4-Slavisa Jokanovic, 5-Miroslav Djukic, 6-Sinisa Mihajlovic, 7-Vladimir Jugovic, 8-Branko Brnovic, 9-Predrag Mijatovic, 10-Dragan Stojkovic, 11-Savo Milosevic (Sasa Curcic, 77th).

Czech Republic: 1-Pavel Srnicek, 2-Radoslav Latal (Karel Poborsky, 86th), 3-Jan Suchoparek, 4-Pavel Nedved (Martin Frydek, 79th), 5-Miroslav Kadlec, 6-Michal Hornak, 7-Jiri Nemec, 8-Vladimir Smicer, 9-Pavel Kuka (Radek Drulak, 71st), 10-Patrik Berger, 11-Radek Bejbl.
